summary: Join our comprehensive course on International Dispute Resolution and Arbitration tailored for the Oil, Gas, and Petrochemical industry and enhance your skills.
lede: Oil, gas and petrochemical dispute resolution applies contract terms, claims records and arbitration procedures to commercial conflicts. For counsel, project, contracts and claims professionals, the course develops practical ways to assess claims, build chronologies and evidence matrices, plan procedures, and prepare settlement strategies and executive reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage disputes, evidence, claims, and arbitration preparation in energy and petrochemical environments.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of petroleum or petrochemical contracts, basic familiarity with dispute clauses, and experience handling project correspondence, claims, or commercial records. Prior exposure to international arbitration, ICC Arbitration Rules, LCIA Arbitration Rules, or the UNCITRAL Model Law is helpful but not mandatory. No coding or programming is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing contract wording, evidence bundles, and schedule-based project records. This course is pitched at an intermediate to advanced level, with advanced concepts taught at operational application level rather than full legal drafting mastery.
